# rms_vpn_hub (Resource)

Manages a Teltonika RMS VPN Hub for secure multi-site connectivity.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rms_vpn_hub" "main" {
  name        = "Production VPN"
  description = "Main VPN hub for production devices"
  company_id  = 123456
  hub_zone    = "frankfurt-1"
  vpn_type    = "tun"
  tag_ids     = [10, 20]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `company_id` (Number) The company ID this VPN hub belongs to.
- `hub_zone` (String) VPN hub server location (e.g., frankfurt-1, bahrain-1).
- `name` (String) VPN hub name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) VPN hub description.
- `tag_ids` (Set of Number) List of tag IDs assigned to this VPN hub.
- `vpn_type` (String) VPN type: tap or tun.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier for the VPN hub.
